Name: Stardew Economy
Author: CleanpupC
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Stardew Economy[/b][/size]
[i]A dynamic economy overhaul for Stardew Valley[/i][/center]
[size=4][b]Overview
[/b][/size]
[b]Stardew Economy[/b] is an economy overhaul mod designed to make money-making in Stardew Valley feel more strategic, varied, and less dominated by the same optimal routines every save.
Instead of letting a handful of crops or methods completely outclass everything else, this mod rebalances profitability across multiple item groups and introduces systems that make the economy feel more dynamic over time.


[size=4][b]Current Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced crop profitability to reduce extreme profit gaps[/*]
[*]Fish value overhaul to better reward harder catches[/*]
[*]Dynamic supply and demand adjustments[/*]
[*]Randomized save-specific market modifiers[/*]
[*]Expanded shop behavior for selected vendors[/*]
[*]Joja can purchase the same items as Pierre[/*]
[*]Joja offers cheaper crop pricing than before[/*]
[*]Clint can purchase weapons and rings[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Latest Update[/b][/size]
[color=#f0ad4e][b]Version 1.0.0[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]GMCM support[/b] has been added for easier in-game configuration[/*]
[*]Made additional [b]Joja pricing and shop tweaks[/b][/*]
[*]Expanded [b]Marlon's shop[/b] with existing items[/*]
[*]Rebalanced A[b]rtisan goods[/b][/*]
[/list]For the full version history, check the [b]Changelog[/b] tab.


[size=4][b]Design Goal[/b][/size]
This mod is not trying to make every item equally valuable.
The goal is to make [i]more playstyles feel viable[/i].
In vanilla Stardew Valley, a small number of strategies often end up clearly stronger than the rest. Stardew Economy is meant to push back against that by making weaker options more competitive and by creating a more active, less static economy.


[size=4][b]Balancing Status:[/b][/size]

Balancing is still being tuned and expanded. Values may continue to change as more categories, mechanics, and economy systems are refined. If you provide feedback, you're more likely to see your own changes

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*]Download [b]Stardew Economy[/b][/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list]Make sure the root mod folder is placed directly inside your [b]Mods[/b] folder and is not left zipped.

For example: /.../StardewValley/Mods/StardewEconomy/

[size=4][b]Compatibility Notes[/b][/size]
This mod changes economy behavior, item values, and some shop logic.
It may conflict with other mods that also modify:
[list]
[*]shop prices[/*]
[*]sell prices[/*]
[*]vendor inventories[/*]
[*]buy/sell logic[/*]
[/list]Mods that only add new items without heavily changing economy systems are more likely to work fine, but anything that directly edits vanilla pricing or shop logic may need testing. If you find issues please notify me, I'll see if there's a fix i can make.

For example, Cornucopia - More Crops seems to work well in initial tests

[size=4][b]Planned Direction[/b][/size]
Future updates are planned to continue expanding economy coverage across more item categories while refining the long-term balance and market systems.
Planned work may include:
[list]
[*]more category-wide balancing[/*]
[*]deeper economy simulation[/*]
[*]additional vendor behavior changes[/*]
[*]continued tuning of early, mid, and late-game profitability[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
Feedback is especially helpful for:
[list]
[*]balance issues[/*]
[*]overpowered or weak strategies[/*]
[*]odd vendor behavior[/*]
[*]bugs or exploits[/*]
[*]pricing that feels unfair or unintuitive[/*]
[/list]If something feels off, broken, or too easily abused, that kind of feedback is extremely useful while the mod is still being actively developed.
